info.title: Fluxora Partner API
info.description: Partner integrations use /api/v1 with partner API key bearer auth. Partner workspace portal: https://partner-eticket.fluxorastudio.id (development: https://dev-partner-eticket.fluxorastudio.id), which uses staff-cookie endpoints under /api/staff/partners/{partnerId}/admin.

servers.description: Production API hostname in current deployment configuration

get.description: Requires events:read. Returns eligible published catalogue owned by the API key partner.

409.description: Conflict, expired quote, inventory or idempotency conflict
